row: 30002792 / OWR-13494-011: Non-ACM line configurations with minimal symbolic initial-degree gap

Existing external publication by Alper Ferudun (2026-10-10), Line Configurations in P^3 Whose Symbolic Square Has Initial Degree alpha(I)+1 Are Coplanar or Pseudostars: A Negative Answer to a Question of Janssen. Exact common result: over every algebraically closed field, any nonempty finite reduced union of lines in P^3 with alpha(I^(2))=alpha(I)+1 is coplanar or a complete pseudostar and hence ACM, answering Janssen Question3.1 negatively. PR293 has a separate resolution/Hodge/Albanese proof and server creation date2026-10-02; historic repository visibility and first-disclosure priority were not adjudicated.
